decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's core recycling-systems business and already shows a strong quantified customer benefit, so a growing German machinery firm would likely continue it.

A mobile slow-speed shredder fits closely with the established portfolio and dedicated website presentation suggests ongoing commitment, even if market proof is still newer than for the flagship concepts.
As a flagship multi-model line aligned with the firm's strategic direction toward modular environmental technology, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The mobile trommel screen is adjacent to the firm's core offer and should benefit from portfolio breadth, although it has less visible evidence of traction than the modular plant concepts.
